info.title: Iroko API
info.description:
REST API for Iroko CRIS — a Current Research Information System backed by
PostgreSQL (source of truth) and Memgraph (graph store). All writes go
through NodeService which atomically updates both stores.

Authentication: Bearer JWT tokens obtained via `/v1/auth/token`.
Most endpoints require authentication. Superuser role required for
admin and crawler endpoints.
